name: Yamaha RCP (Rivage PM, CL/QL, TF, DM3/DM5/DM7, RIO, TIO, RSio)
notes: Actions and feedbacks are generated at runtime from the parameter tables in schemas/*.txt, one table per console model chosen in the connection config (src/paramFuncs.ts:19-70 getParams). The catalog reproduces that generation (src/actions.ts createAction and updateActions, src/feedbacks.ts createFeedbackFromAction) for every table and merges the result: one entry per command, not per channel. Channel and bus numbers are the X and Y options.

Provenance of generated entries points to the line of the command in the schema table of the first model that has it (file under schemas/). The generating code is src/actions.ts:21-212 (options) and src/actions.ts:214-423 (registration).

Model to table: CL/QL = CLQL Parameters-1.txt, PM (Rivage PM) = Rivage Parameters-4.txt, TF = TF Parameters-1.txt, DM3 = DM3 Parameters-2.txt, DM7 (also DM5) = DM7 Parameters-2.txt, RIO, TIO and RSIO have their own small tables (src/paramFuncs.ts:27-52). The README additionally names TF-Rack and DM5 as supported; there is no separate table for them.

The availability text of each entry lists the console models whose table registers it. A command is an action when its RW column contains w, a feedback when it contains r; every readable command also gets a value feedback named <id>_Value. Table rows whose first column is not OK, OKM or NOTIFY are ignored by the module and are not catalogued.

Action and feedback ids are the command address with ":" replaced by "_" (for example MIXER_Current/InCh/Fader/Level). The X and Y options are 1-based in the UI and converted to 0-based when the command is sent; X may also hold an array as JSON text (src/actions.ts callback). Options of type "other" differ in type between models.

Options of dropdown type use allowCustom: any value, not only the listed ids, is accepted. Level and parameter values are text inputs (fader in dB, "-Inf" allowed); the "Relative" checkbox exists for readable integer commands, and the Toggle choice for readable on/off commands.

Scene commands (MIXER_Lib/Scene/Recall, Store, RecallInc, RecallDec; Index 1000 to 1011) and meter commands (Index 2000 and above, readable only: value feedbacks) are part of the tables and are included. The module sends scenes with different wire commands per model (src/paramFuncs.ts:fmtCmd); that mapping is not part of the catalog. Presets, variables and the upgrade script are not catalogued.
Built on @companion-module/base ^2.2.0: expressions are supported for option values.
Repository yamaha-scp (legacy id) redirects to this repository; yamaha-dm is an unmodified module template (see the unusable section of the index).
